name: The Woodshed
description: The Woodshed is a lively venue that combines a casual restaurant atmosphere with karaoke and open mic nights. It features a friendly, welcoming crowd and a relaxed vibe, making it a great spot for both locals and visitors. The venue offers outdoor seating, live music, and a variety of food and drink options. Its community-oriented environment and occasional themed nights create a fun, inclusive experience perfect for groups and families alike.
